title: The Executioner
description: A hero should never kill anyone, not even the worst of villains. Gangyu has always followed that principle, even though he never truly understood why his fellow heroes lived by it. But after a villain destroys his team and kills his brother in prison, Gangyu finally breaks his vow. With permission to execute death-row criminals, he enters the notorious prison Ruculus as its executioner. Now he must fight through its dangerous villains and eliminate the worst of them all.
author: Jong Soo
